name: DMV Reduced-Fee ID Card
description: $11 reduced-fee state ID for eligible residents using form DL 937 (regular fee $40)
fullDescription: The California Department of Motor Vehicles offers reduced-fee identification cards for income-eligible residents, providing an affordable way to obtain government-issued photo ID.
whatTheyOffer:
- Reduced-fee state ID card ($11 instead of the regular $40)
- Reduced fee applies to original, renewal, replacement, and information-change ID applications
- Valid government-issued photo identification
- No-fee ID cards are also available for people experiencing homelessness and seniors 62+
howToGetIt:
1. Contact your local public assistance agency or the governmental or nonprofit program you receive services from
2. Ask them to verify your eligibility and complete the Verification for Reduced Fee Identification Card form (DL 937)
3. Take the completed DL 937 form to a DMV office
4. Complete the ID card application and pay the reduced fee
keywords: DMV, ID card, identification, reduced fee, low-income, DL 937, state ID, photo ID, public assistance
